title: 自动踩灭烟头导致15000美元罚款，而留下烟头则没问题。
description: 自动踩灭烟头导致15000美元罚款，而留下烟头则没问题。
evidence: I got a 15000 dollar fine for an automatic action by my character of stamping out a cigarette butt on a space station.  If you just leave the butt there no problem.  If you let the character automatically stamp it out you get arrested.
